name: curated-faq-holdout
instruction: Retrieve the most relevant FAQ article and return article_id and its answer.

cases.input: Where can I download the company brand logo?

billing_faq.question: Download monthly invoice billing statement
billing_faq.answer: Open Billing, select the month, and choose Download invoice.

billing_faq.question: Refund duplicate payment charge
billing_faq.answer: Send the two payment references to the billing team for review.

billing_faq.question: Cancel automatic renewal subscription
billing_faq.answer: Turn off Auto-renew in Billing before the renewal date.

access_faq.question: Reset forgotten account password
access_faq.answer: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the email link.

access_faq.question: Replace lost authenticator device
access_faq.answer: Sign in with a recovery code, then register a new authenticator.

access_faq.question: Invite teammate workspace membership
access_faq.answer: Open Workspace settings, choose Members, then Invite.

shipping_faq.question: Track package delivery shipment
shipping_faq.answer: Open the order and follow its carrier tracking link.

shipping_faq.question: Change delivery shipping address
shipping_faq.answer: Edit the shipping address before the order enters dispatch.

legacy_faq.question: Send purchase order by fax
legacy_faq.answer: Fax ordering has been retired; use the online order form.

legacy_faq.question: Install application from CD-ROM disc
legacy_faq.answer: Disc installers are unsupported; download the current installer.

marketing_faq.question: Download company brand logo
marketing_faq.answer: Download the approved logo files from the brand assets page.

marketing_faq.question: Use promotional product photographs
marketing_faq.answer: Use the approved image library and include the supplied credits.

expected.answer: Download the approved logo files from the brand assets page.
